queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:novoton_hotels` ( `hotel_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'IdHotel from API', `product_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'CS-Cart product ID', `hotel_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Hotel name from API', `city` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'City/Resort from API', `region` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Region from API', `country` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Country from API', `hotel_type` varchar(50) DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'e.g. 4*, 3* Sup, Apart (raw from API)', `star_rating` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Parsed numeric rating 1-5', `property_type` varchar(20) DEFAULT 'hotel' COMMENT 'Detected: hotel,villa,apartment,chalet,guest-house,resort,hostel,motel,boarding-house,cabin', `is_adults_only` enum('Y','N') DEFAULT 'N' COMMENT 'Detected from hotel name: Adults Only, 18+, etc.', `latitude` decimal(10,8) DEFAULT NULL, `longitude` decimal(11,8) DEFAULT NULL, `street_address` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Reverse-geocoded street (OSM Nominatim), approximate — API has no street field', `geocoded_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Last reverse-geocode attempt (stamped even when no street found)', `hotel_data` JSON COMMENT 'JSON: full hotelinfo API response', `has_room_price` enum('Y','N') DEFAULT 'N' COMMENT 'Has room_price check results', `packages_count` int(3) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Number of packages for this hotel', `hotelinfo_synced_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Last hotelinfo API sync', `hotel_list_synced_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Last hotel_list API sync', `last_price_check` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Last room_price_check result', `calendar_prices_raw` JSON COMMENT 'JSON: precomputed per-date raw EUR prices for calendar display', `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`hotel_id`), KEY `idx_product_id` (`product_id`), KEY `idx_country` (`country`), KEY `idx_star_rating` (`star_rating`), KEY `idx_property_type` (`property_type`), KEY `idx_city_country` (`city`, `country`), KEY `idx_has_room_price` (`has_room_price`), KEY `idx_hotelinfo_synced` (`hotelinfo_synced_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Hotels from Novoton API'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:novoton_hotel_packages` ( `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `hotel_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'FK to novoton_hotels.hotel_id', `package_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'IdCont from hotelinfo API', `package_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'PackageName from API', `priceinfo_data` JSON COMMENT 'JSON: full priceinfo API response (seasons, prices, early_booking)', `seasons_count` int(3) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Number of seasons in priceinfo', `has_early_booking` enum('Y','N') DEFAULT 'N' COMMENT 'Has EB discounts', `min_price` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Lowest adult price for quick filtering', `currency` varchar(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EUR', `needs_price_compute` enum('Y','N') DEFAULT 'N' COMMENT 'Flag: price metadata needs recomputation by compute_prices cron', `synced_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Last priceinfo sync date', `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `idx_hotel_package` (`hotel_id`, `package_id`), KEY `idx_hotel_id` (`hotel_id`), KEY `idx_package_name` (`package_name`(100)), KEY `idx_min_price` (`min_price`), KEY `idx_synced_at` (`synced_at`), KEY `idx_needs_price_compute` (`needs_price_compute`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Hotel packages from hotelinfo API with priceinfo'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:novoton_bookings` ( `booking_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `order_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `product_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `user_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'CS-Cart user ID if logged in', `session_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Session ID for guest bookings', `novoton_confirm_id` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Confirmation from Novoton API', `novoton_invoice_id` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'IdNum from API', `novoton_res_num` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ResNum from resinfo', `novoton_status` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Good, ASK, ST, WT, RQ', `hotel_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL, `hotel_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `package_id` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL, `package_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `room_id` varchar(100) NOT NULL, `room_type` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `board_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL, `board_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Board type display name', `item_id` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'CS-Cart order_details.item_id', `check_in` date NOT NULL, `check_out` date NOT NULL, `nights` int(3) NOT NULL, `adults` int(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, `children` int(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `children_ages` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Comma-separated ages', `num_rooms` int(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT 'Number of rooms booked', `rooms_data` JSON COMMENT 'JSON: rooms configuration with guests per room', `room_number` int(2) DEFAULT 1 COMMENT 'Which room in multi-room booking', `total_rooms` int(2) DEFAULT 1 COMMENT 'Total rooms in original booking', `guest_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `guest_email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `guest_phone` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL, `guests_data` JSON COMMENT 'JSON: all guests details', `holder_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Main holder name', `base_price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL, `extras_price` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT 0, `total_price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL, `api_price` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Price returned from API', `currency` varchar(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EUR', `status` enum('pending','confirmed','cancelled','completed','failed','ask','waiting') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', `api_request` JSON COMMENT 'JSON: API request sent', `api_response` JSON COMMENT 'JSON: API response received', `alternatives_data` JSON COMMENT 'JSON: alternative hotels from API', `alternatives_requested` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Whether alternatives were requested', `last_status_check` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Last time status was polled', `notes` text, `terms_of_payment_raw` text COMMENT 'Raw payment terms from API', `terms_of_cancellation_raw` text COMMENT 'Raw cancellation terms from API', `terms_of_payment_formatted` text COMMENT 'Formatted payment terms for display', `terms_of_cancellation_formatted` text COMMENT 'Formatted cancellation terms for display', `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`booking_id`), KEY `idx_order` (`order_id`), KEY `idx_product` (`product_id`), KEY `idx_user` (`user_id`), KEY `idx_hotel` (`hotel_id`), KEY `idx_status` (`status`), KEY `idx_novoton_status` (`novoton_status`), KEY `idx_dates` (`check_in`, `check_out`), KEY `idx_novoton_confirm` (`novoton_confirm_id`), KEY `idx_novoton_invoice` (`novoton_invoice_id`), KEY `idx_order_status` (`order_id`, `status`), KEY `idx_session_id` (`session_id`), KEY `idx_user_created` (`user_id`, `created_at`), KEY `idx_hotel_status` (`hotel_id`, `status`), KEY `idx_item_id` (`item_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Booking records'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:novoton_sync_log` ( `log_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `sync_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'hotels' COMMENT 'Type: hotel_list, hotelinfo, sync_priceinfo, facilities, offers_update, exchange_rates, resinfo', `sync_date` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `products_total` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `products_updated` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `products_failed` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `products_no_data` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `products_missing` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `duration_seconds` int(11) DEFAULT NULL, `log_file` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `error_message` text, `notes` text DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Extra JSON data for sync details', `status` enum('running','completed','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running', PRIMARY KEY (`log_id`), KEY `idx_date` (`sync_date`), KEY `idx_status` (`status`), KEY `idx_sync_type` (`sync_type`), KEY `idx_type_status_date` (`sync_type`, `status`, `sync_date`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Sync operation logs'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:novoton_cache` ( `cache_key` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, `cache_data` MEDIUMTEXT, `expires_at` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT 'Unix timestamp', `created_at` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Unix timestamp', PRIMARY KEY (`cache_key`), KEY `idx_expires` (`expires_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Cached API responses for live data'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:novoton_alternative_requests` ( `request_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `hotel_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL, `hotel_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `check_in` date NOT NULL, `check_out` date NOT NULL, `nights` int(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Number of nights', `num_rooms` int(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT 'Number of rooms requested', `adults` int(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, `children` int(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `children_ages` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL, `room_id` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL, `room_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `board_id` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL, `board_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL, `contact_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `contact_email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `contact_phone` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL, `notes` text, `status` enum('pending','pending_manual','alternatives_found','notified','booked','expired','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', `novoton_request_id` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'IdNum from hotel_request', `api_request_xml` text COMMENT 'XML sent to API (masked)', `api_response` text COMMENT 'Raw API response', `alternatives_data` JSON COMMENT 'JSON: found alternatives', `notified_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`request_id`), KEY `idx_user_id` (`user_id`), KEY `idx_hotel_id` (`hotel_id`), KEY `idx_status` (`status`), KEY `idx_novoton_request_id` (`novoton_request_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Alternative booking requests'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:novoton_facilities` ( `facility_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `facility_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT '', `facility_name_en` varchar(255) DEFAULT '', `facility_name_ro` varchar(255) DEFAULT '', `facility_type` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'hotel_facility' COMMENT 'CS-Cart feature type: hotel_facility, room_facility, travel_group, beach_access, etc.', `feature_variant_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL, `synced_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`facility_id`), KEY `idx_facility_type` (`facility_type`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Hotel facilities list'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:novoton_hotel_facilities` ( `hotel_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL, `facility_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`hotel_id`, `facility_id`), KEY `idx_facility_id` (`facility_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Hotel-facility relationships'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:novoton_resorts` ( `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `resort_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `country` varchar(100) NOT NULL, `synced_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `idx_resort_country` (`resort_name`(191), `country`), KEY `idx_country` (`country`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Resort names synced from Novoton API'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:novoton_destination_whitelist` ( `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `country` varchar(100) NOT NULL, `resort` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `selection_type` enum('all','specific') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'specific', `reviewed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Last Save: resorts first seen after this are new', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_country_resort` (`country`, `resort`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Novoton destinations we sell'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:hotel_feature_mappings` ( `mapping_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `provider` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'novoton' COMMENT 'Provider name (novoton, sphinx)', `feature_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'property_rating, meals, hotel_facility, room_facility, resort, property_type', `provider_code` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Provider-side code (AI, HB, 4, facility_id, resort name)', `cs_cart_feature_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'CS-Cart product_features.feature_id (from addon settings)', `cs_cart_variant_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'CS-Cart product_feature_variants.variant_id (auto-populated)', `cs_cart_feature_type` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'S' COMMENT 'S=SelectBox, M=MultipleCheckboxes (cached from CS-Cart)', `display_name_en` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'English display name for variant creation', `display_name_ro` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Romanian display name for variant creation', `position` int(5) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Sort position for the variant', `is_active` enum('Y','N') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y', `mapping_source` enum('seed','auto','manual') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed' COMMENT 'Origin: seed=install, auto=API discovery, manual=admin', `variant_source` enum('auto','manual') DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'How variant was resolved: auto=name-match/create, manual=admin override', `last_synced_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Last time this code was seen from the API', `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`mapping_id`), UNIQUE KEY `idx_provider_type_code` (`provider`, `feature_type`, `provider_code`(191)), KEY `idx_feature_type` (`feature_type`), KEY `idx_cs_cart_feature` (`cs_cart_feature_id`), KEY `idx_active` (`is_active`), KEY `idx_mapping_source` (`mapping_source`), KEY `idx_unmapped` (`is_active`, `cs_cart_variant_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Maps provider codes to CS-Cart feature variants'
